kuwait.title: Flag of Kuwait

colors.note: Represents blood shed in defence of the nation

desc:
- A horizontal triband of green, white, and red with a black trapezoid on the hoist side
- Adopted on 7 September 1961, shortly after independence from Britain, and officially hoisted on 24 November 1961
- The colours are inspired by a poem by Safie Al-Deen Al-Hili
trivia:
- The black trapezoid represents the enemy; the green represents Islamic faith; red represents bloodshed
- The white represents purity and peaceful intentions
- Kuwait adopted this flag in 1961 upon independence from Britain
